ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 45% high-intensity white to 55% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe shows dominant white contiguous field with black spotting; right lobe displays high-density black-and-white mottling and circular patterns; central area is predominantly solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a pixel angle approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography with frequent, high-amplitude jagged serrations and deep missing segments along the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature from notch to tips, heavily modified by large-scale irregular edge indentations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of circular rosette clusters, particularly concentrated on the distal end of the right lobe; isolated dark rings on the white regions of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several parallel diagonal linear markings (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the left lobe; vertical linear disruptions on the dark regions of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural trauma along the trailing edge, featuring deep, irregular notches and significant missing sections compared to a smooth curve.
other_distinctive_markers: The right fluke tip is characterized by an exceptionally dense and complex overlapping arrangement of circular scars, creating a high-frequency contrast area.
